items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: No. Well, there was a fellow called Charlie Chicken Jones, but I think he's dead.

ctx.x: I believe he's dead. Somebody told me he was, uh, Cootie Williams' teacher, I believe, too. Yeah. Did you know Cootie Williams, who played with Ellington? Sure. I know him. There's another old man whom I didn't get to meet, who still is there. I'll meet him my next trip. They called him Chicken. Some people said they could only remember his name. No. It was Chicken. Do you remember that name?
No. Well, there was a fellow called Charlie Chicken Jones, but I think he's dead.
Oh, yeah. Chicken Jones. Chicken Jones. Chicken Jones. Uh-huh.
